auroc_note: auroc_usable_binary is a BINARY score, so it equals balanced accuracy at 0.5 and is a coarse summary; auroc_progress_graded uses the 3-level task_progress field and is the more informative number
ci95_type: none at experiment level; per-arm CI is factory-grouped bootstrap (2000 draws, seed 0) over the 14 factories of this subset
cost: V03 made 122 image API calls (cap 122 = 120 arm calls + 2 negative-control calls); the shared sub-stream ledger also holds V01's 20 calls, total 142 image calls; 0 text calls
device: API call (OpenCode Go Responses); sheets built on CPU
honesty: the model is probabilistic; nothing here is deterministic
the usable=true share of ALL answers is reported per arm (documented success bias)
one labeller; a ranker/reviewer result, not an accuracy claim
the subset is balanced, so no rate here is a base rate
label_source: human labels, ONE labeller (Egocentric-10K OOD-160 subset); all 10 bad windows are NO_ACTIVE_WORK

protocol: 20-window pre-registered stratified subset (10 bad / 10 good -- BALANCED, therefore NOT representative of the base rate), six arms x 20 windows on the SAME windows, plus two contentless-sheet negative controls; factory-grouped bootstrap CI (2000 draws, seed 0)
reference_why: arm (e) is the default 12-tile labelled sheet with only the reasoning step removed, the closest in-budget analogue of V02's primary arm; the true primary (quality on 12 tiles) is V02's job and was not re-bought
